lanes.BOUNDED_SERVICE_OR_TOOL: Use through a bounded service/tool adapter with separate authority.
lanes.COGNITION_PROVIDER_CONTRACT: Admit only through the generic cognition-provider contract after qualification.
lanes.EXTERNAL_NODE_OR_CLIENT: Treat as a client/device/node surface, not a boot dependency.
lanes.OPTIONAL_RESEARCH_ADAPTER: Research/donor capability; adapt only after evidence and qualification.
lanes.PACKAGE_SELF_CONTAINED_RUNTIME: Package the self-contained Vera Mono runtime into VeraOS.
lanes.PORTAL_MANAGED_PROJECT: Keep available as a managed project/application rather than resident OS machinery.
lanes.PORTAL_ON_DEMAND_SPECIALIST: Expose through P.O.R.T.A.L. as an on-demand specialist.
lanes.PROVENANCE_RECORD_ONLY: Retain source/provenance only; never activate as runtime.
lanes.VERAOS_SERVICE_ADAPTER: Bind through a governed VeraOS service/adapter boundary.
lanes.VERA_MONO_ABSORBED_REASONING: Use Vera Mono's absorbed Rezon package while preserving Rezon source ownership/provenance.
lanes.VERA_MONO_ABSORPTION: Reuse mechanisms already absorbed into Vera Mono; do not depend on donor repo at runtime.
